correctness.rationale: For invertible qubit T=UA, Bloch normalization has c=2g/(1+g²), d=(1−g²)/(1+g²). Maximization of the pure-state postselection displacement gives G(A)=g=(a−b)/(a+b). When g≤1/√3, averaging the exact Bloch inner product along the latitude z=−g yields at least one input with disturbance≥g uniformly over SO(3) polar-unitary rotations; when g≥1/√3 the equator average gives G(T)≥g/sqrt(1+g²)≥1/2. Consequently G(T)<1/2 implies G(A)≤G(T). Nonzero singular operators have disturbance supremum one and are excluded. Completeness and equality of outcome probabilities follow from sum |M_y|²=I. Independently rechecked the rotation-angle algebra, boundary g=1/√3 and the trace-distance factor 1/2.
